scripts.cap:sync: npm run build:web && npx cap sync && node scripts/fix-ios-spm-paths.cjs
scripts.cap:android: npm run build:web && npx cap open android
scripts.prepare:ios: npm run build:web && npx cap sync ios && node scripts/fix-ios-spm-paths.cjs
scripts.cap:ios: npm run prepare:ios && npx cap open ios
scripts.android:aab: npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
scripts.android:apk: npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
